candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Електронски систем за јавни набавки (Public Access portal)
candidates.why_relevant: National e-procurement system of North Macedonia; the single mandatory publication point for tender notices (огласи), award decisions and contract notices by all contracting authorities. Any purchase of banking, payment, card, POS, cash-handling or e-banking services by a ministry, municipality, fund or state enterprise surfaces here with requirement, estimated value and winning bidder.
candidates.access_status: public, no login for PublicAccess area; bidding requires registration
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scrape of PublicAccess notice search filtered by CPV 66100000 (banking and investment services), 66110000, 66600000, 72000000 IT-services and keyword sets; ASP.NET postback form navigation required, so use a headless browser session rather than plain HTTP GET
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from Ministry of Finance and BJN pages
queries_used: Електронски систем за јавни набавки Северна Македонија e-nabavki оглас платежни услуги банка
e-nabavki.gov.mk PublicAccess огласи Реализирани договори планови за јавни набавки

candidates.source_name: ЕСЈН — Реализирани договори (executed/realised contracts register)
candidates.why_relevant: Post-award layer of the ESJN: notifications of contracts actually executed, with realised values per contracting authority. Gives actual spend on banking/payment services rather than only the estimated tender value — the best proxy for wallet size of each incumbent bank/PSP in the public sector.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Headless-browser pagination of the institution grid; join to notice IDs from the main ESJN scrape
queries_used: Службен весник Македонија регистар на договори јавни набавки отворени податоци

candidates.source_name: Биро за јавни набавки (BJN) — Public Procurement Bureau
candidates.why_relevant: Regulator/operator of the procurement system under the Ministry of Finance. Publishes methodology, annual reports on the procurement market, user manuals (incl. the e-Pazar electronic marketplace), lists of authorised persons for e-guarantees (a direct pointer to which banks issue electronic bid guarantees — a payments-adjacent product line), and rule changes that alter how banking services are tendered.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS/news-page polling plus PDF harvest of annual reports and guidance documents
queries_used: Биро за јавни набавки Македонија договор банкарски услуги

candidates.source_name: BJN — Овластени лица за е-гаранции (authorised issuers of electronic bid guarantees)
candidates.why_relevant: Names the banks/insurers accredited to issue electronic guarantees inside the ESJN. Reveals which financial institutions have integrated with state digital infrastructure — a leading indicator of bank-side digital capability and of the addressable market for e-guarantee tooling.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic diff of the page contents to detect newly accredited institutions
queries_used: Биро за јавни набавки Македонија договор банкарски услуги

candidates.source_name: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки (State Appeals Commission) — decisions
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes filed appeals daily and full decisions from its sessions. Appeals on banking/payment/IT tenders expose competitor pricing arguments, disqualification grounds, technical-spec disputes and which vendors fight for which public accounts — intelligence not present in the award notice itself.
candidates.access_status: public; also mirrored at dkzjn.mk and a sorsix-hosted instance — domain in flux, treat as unverified
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the decisions/appeals listing, harvest PDFs, OCR where scanned, filter by respondent contracting authority and CPV/subject keywords
queries_used: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки dkzjn.mk одлуки
local_language_terms_used: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки

candidates.source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement)
candidates.why_relevant: Above-threshold MK notices and EU/IFI-funded contracts touching MK financial infrastructure are published here, in English, with structured CPV coding and a documented API. Also captures EU-institution contracts naming MK as place of performance that never appear on the national portal.
candidates.access_status: public, open API and bulk downloads
candidates.legal_status: official EU publication, open data / reuse permitted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: TED Search API expert query filtering country=MK and CPV 661*, 6612*, 6660*, 7200*; nightly incremental pull
queries_used: TED tenders europa.eu North Macedonia banking services tender notice

candidates.source_name: Opentender — North Macedonia portal (Government Transparency Institute)
candidates.why_relevant: Third-party normalised and analysable mirror of MK national + TED procurement data, with buyer/supplier entity pages and indicators. Far easier to query than the ASP.NET national portal, and useful for time-series of who wins financial-services contracts. Must be treated as a derived source — completeness lags the primary portal.
candidates.access_status: public web UI; bulk data via OCP registry
candidates.legal_status: open data (OCDS), reuse permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the OCDS bulk package from the OCP Data Registry entry for North Macedonia, then filter locally by CPV and buyer
candidates.discovered_via_method: English search + snowball to OCP Data Registry
queries_used: opentender.eu North Macedonia procurement data

candidates.source_name: OCP Data Registry — North Macedonia publication entry
candidates.why_relevant: Metadata pointer describing where MK contracting data comes from, its coverage window, format and download endpoints. Use it to decide whether bulk OCDS beats scraping, and to detect when coverage breaks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly check of the registry entry for dataset refresh dates and download links
queries_used: opentender.eu North Macedonia procurement data

candidates.source_name: EBRD Procurement Notices / ECEPP client e-procurement portal
candidates.why_relevant: EBRD-financed contracts in MK (financial-sector TA, FI credit lines, operational and financial performance improvement programmes for state utilities) generate general procurement notices, invitations for tenders and consultancy assignments. Donor-funded financial infrastructure work often never reaches the national portal.
candidates.access_status: notices public; ECEPP requires free registration to see full documents
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the notices listing filtered by country=North Macedonia and sector=financial institutions; cross-check EBRD project summary pages for the same project IDs
queries_used: EBRD procurement notice North Macedonia payment system financial sector project

candidates.source_name: World Bank — North Macedonia project documents & procurement plans (STEP)
candidates.why_relevant: Procurement plans for MK projects implemented by the Ministry of Finance — notably P176366 'Building Effective, Transparent and Accountable Public Financial Management Institutions' — list forthcoming packages (treasury/PFM IT, payment and reporting systems) with method, estimated cost and timing, months before any tender is advertised. Strongest forward-looking pipeline signal in this cell.
candidates.source_subtype: IFI project document repository / procurement plan
candidates.access_status: public documents API and full-text .txt renderings
candidates.legal_status: open access under World Bank access-to-information policy
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Documents & Reports API query country=North Macedonia, doc type=Procurement Plan; parse the .txt renderings for package descriptions and CPV-like keywords; watch project P176366 for updates
queries_used: World Bank procurement STEP notice North Macedonia financial sector payment Request for Bids Ministry of Finance

candidates.source_name: WBIF — Western Balkans Investment Framework tenders & opportunities
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregates EU/IFI blended-finance procurement for the Western Balkans including MK. Technical assistance packages here frequently cover financial-sector reform, PFM and digitalisation, and name the beneficiary institution.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the procurements listing, filter beneficiary country = North Macedonia
queries_used: EIB European Investment Bank procurement notices North Macedonia KfW tender financial sector Skopje

candidates.source_name: EIB — North Macedonia country page & EIB procurement
candidates.why_relevant: EIB project pipeline for MK, including work with the National Bank and commercial banks under the Greening Financial Systems programme. Signed/appraisal-stage entries indicate where promoter-run tenders will follow; the EIB corporate procurement page covers EIB's own consultancy contracts.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the country project list for status changes; separately monitor eib.org/en/about/procurement for corporate calls
queries_used: EIB European Investment Bank procurement notices North Macedonia KfW tender financial sector Skopje

candidates.source_name: Народна банка на РСМ — Јавни набавки (central bank procurement page)
candidates.why_relevant: The central bank is itself a contracting authority and a buyer of payment-system, cash-processing, security-printing and core-IT services. Its procurement page is the highest-value single buyer in this cell for payments infrastructure.
candidates.access_status: public page; content may be thin and mostly link out to ESJN
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page-diff monitoring plus an ESJN filter on the NBRSM as договорен орган
queries_used: Народна банка на Република Северна Македонија јавни набавки оглас

candidates.source_name: Министерство за финансии — Јавни набавки / Е-јавни набавки
candidates.why_relevant: The Ministry of Finance owns the Treasury and the state's payment relationships and is the policy owner of procurement. Its own procurement notices plus the archived огласи-и-договори pages cover treasury systems, banking service contracts and PFM IT.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl current and archive (arhiva.finance.gov.mk) procurement sections; also harvest the internal-audit annual reports which describe contracted banking arrangements
queries_used: Електронски систем за јавни набавки Северна Македонија e-nabavki оглас платежни услуги банка

candidates.source_name: Министерство за дигитална трансформација — Јавни набавки
candidates.why_relevant: Owner of national digitalisation, e-services and e-payment gateway initiatives. Its tenders are the leading indicator for government digital-payment acceptance and identity/e-signature infrastructure that banks and PSPs plug into.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Page-diff monitoring plus ESJN filter on this contracting authority
queries_used: Електронски систем за јавни набавки Северна Македонија e-nabavki оглас платежни услуги банка

candidates.source_name: Град Скопје — Сектор за јавни набавки (and municipal procurement pages generally)
candidates.why_relevant: Municipalities are heavy buyers of банкарски услуги (account operation, payment collection, POS acceptance for local fees, parking and transport ticketing). The City of Skopje is the largest single municipal buyer and its page also states the legal publication chain (ESJN, Official Gazette, EU Official Journal).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Treat as a template: enumerate the ~81 municipalities' procurement pages, but prioritise the ESJN buyer filter over per-site scraping
queries_used: Службен весник Македонија Закон за јавните набавки регистар на договори

candidates.source_name: Државен завод за ревизија (State Audit Office) — ревизорски извештаи
candidates.why_relevant: Audit reports on ministries, funds, state enterprises and bodies such as the Central Register routinely describe bank accounts, payment-transaction arrangements and procurement irregularities in named contracts. Also publishes its audit plan and its list of auditable entities — a ready-made map of public buyers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the report index by year and entity, harvest PDFs, full-text search for банкарски услуги, платен промет, провизија, сметка
queries_used: Државен завод за ревизија ревизорски извештај банкарски услуги платен промет институција Македонија

candidates.source_name: Центар за граѓански комуникации (Center for Civil Communications) — procurement monitoring
candidates.why_relevant: The main independent watchdog analysing MK procurement: semi-annual monitoring reports, a 'rationality index' comparing prices paid by institutions for identical services, red-flag case studies, and single-bidder statistics. Provides interpretation and anomaly detection that raw ESJN data does not.
candidates.access_status: public reports, mk and en versions
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor publications page for new monitoring reports; harvest PDFs; also track media pickup (mia.mk, 360stepeni, time.mk) for release timing
queries_used: Центар за граѓански комуникации мониторинг јавни набавки извештај Македонија

candidates.source_name: Слободен пристап / АСПИ — FOI request platform and register of information holders
candidates.why_relevant: Freedom-of-information channel and register of all public information holders, including the Appeals Commission and BJN. Where a contract document is not published, an FOI request is the lawful retrieval route; the register itself is a clean actor map of public buyers.
candidates.access_status: public; submitting requests needs an account
candidates.legal_status: statutory FOI regime (Law on Free Access to Public Information)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use as a manual escalation channel plus scrape the aspi.mk holder register for the buyer actor map
queries_used: Државна комисија за жалби по јавни набавки dkzjn.mk одлуки
local_language_terms_used: слободен пристап до информации од јавен карактер

candidates.source_name: data.gov.mk — Биро за јавни набавки organisation datasets
candidates.why_relevant: National open-data portal hosting BJN-published datasets. If procurement datasets are maintained there, they give a licensed, machine-readable alternative to scraping the ESJN. The organisation page slug appeared transliterated/garbled in search results, so the exact dataset list needs verification.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the portal API for organisation=Биро за јавни набавки and for keyword јавни набавки; check dataset freshness before relying on it

candidates.source_name: Закон за јавните набавки (Law on Public Procurement) — consolidated texts
candidates.why_relevant: Defines thresholds, procedure types, mandatory publication points and exemptions — including how financial services are treated. Necessary to interpret why some banking contracts never appear as open tenders (negotiated/exempt procedures) and to calibrate collection completeness expectations.
candidates.access_status: public; consolidated texts also mirrored on municipal sites and dejure.mk
candidates.legal_status: official legislation, published in Службен весник (24/19, 87/21 and later amendments)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off ingestion plus amendment watch via Службен весник
queries_used: Службен весник Македонија Закон за јавните набавки регистар на договори

candidates.source_name: US ITA Country Commercial Guide — North Macedonia: Selling to the Public Sector
candidates.why_relevant: English-language orientation to how MK public procurement actually works for foreign vendors — thresholds, portal mechanics, IFI-financed routes and known frictions. Useful onboarding context and a cross-check on the legal reading, refreshed roughly annually.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual re-fetch and diff

negative_findings.description: Neither Macedonian- nor English-language search surfaced a specific, currently-open tender for платежни услуги / банкарски услуги from a MK public body. Search engines index the ESJN's ASP.NET notice pages very poorly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Portal-level sources found and documented, but no individual banking/payment notice retrievable via general web search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot be worked by web search alone — collection must go through the ESJN's own search UI (or OCDS bulk data), driven by CPV codes and buyer filters.

negative_findings.description: A TED query for North Macedonia banking-services notices returned only an unrelated MK goods notice (road-marking machine, 200814-2025). No MK financial-services notice was located through general search.
negative_findings.result_summary: TED confirmed as a valid channel for MK notices, but banking-specific MK notices were not surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MK is not an EU member, so its notices reach TED only above thresholds or via EU/IFI-funded procedures; TED should be treated as a supplement to, not a substitute for, the national portal.

negative_findings.description: The State Appeals Commission appears under at least three hosts — dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and dkzjn.sorsix.com — with documents served from more than one. Which is canonical was not established, and no fetch was attempted to confirm liveness.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three candidate hosts recorded; canonical host unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector pinned to the wrong host will silently stop receiving decisions after a migration.

negative_findings.description: The data.gov.mk organisation URL for the Public Procurement Bureau appeared as a mojibake/transliterated slug (bnpo-3a-jabhn-ha6abkn), suggesting Cyrillic-to-Latin corruption somewhere in the portal or the index.
negative_findings.result_summary: Dataset list for BJN on the open-data portal not confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Open data may be a cheaper collection route than scraping; its actual existence and freshness need direct verification before planning around it.

negative_findings.description: No Macedonian-language equivalents were used for the IFI/donor sources (EBRD, EIB, World Bank, WBIF, TED) because these bodies publish MK-related procurement in English only; MK-language mirrors of their notices were not found.
negative_findings.result_summary: IFI layer of this cell is English-only by nature.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring will structurally miss donor-funded financial-infrastructure procurement; the English channel is mandatory, not optional, for full coverage.

coverage_gaps.description: State-owned enterprises and public funds that are large payment buyers — ЕСМ (power utility), Македонски железници, Фонд за здравствено осигурување (ФЗОМ), Фонд за ПИОМ, Управа за јавни приходи (UJP), Царинска управа, Македонска пошта, водоводни ЈП and public transport (ЈСП Скопје) — were not individually researched in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate these buyers from the DZR list of auditable entities and the ESJN contracting-authority directory, then add each as a buyer filter rather than a separate scraped site.

coverage_gaps.description: No CPV-code-driven search was executed (66100000 банкарски и инвестициски услуги, 66110000, 66172000 обработка на трансакции, 66600000 трезорски услуги, 30162000/POS equipment, 48440000 финансиски софтвер).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the ESJN and TED searches by CPV rather than free text; free-text Macedonian search on the portal is noisy because 'банка' also matches unrelated collateral and guarantee clauses.

coverage_gaps.description: The ESJN is an ASP.NET WebForms application whose notice search relies on postbacks; no attempt was made to establish whether an API, RSS feed or bulk export exists, and no robots.txt or terms-of-use review was done.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Deterministic pass should probe for RSS/JSON endpoints, check robots.txt and the portal terms, and only then decide between headless-browser scraping and the Opentender/OCDS derived route.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian-language procurement publications (Agjencia/Byroja e prokurimeve publike, njoftim për prokurim publik, shërbime bankare) were not searched, although Albanian is an official language and many municipalities publish bilingually.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add an Albanian query set and check whether the ESJN and larger municipalities issue parallel Albanian notices.

coverage_gaps.description: Other IFI/donor channels touching MK financial infrastructure were not covered: IFC, KfW/GIZ (only referenced indirectly), UNDP MK procurement, EU IPA/EU Delegation to North Macedonia calls, and the Council of Europe Development Bank.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add each as a dedicated source with country and sector filters; EU IPA and the EU Delegation in Skopje are the most likely to fund payments/PFM digitalisation.

coverage_gaps.description: No assessment was made of how far back the ESJN public archive, the executed-contracts register or the Appeals Commission decisions go, nor of retention/purge behaviour.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish the earliest retrievable year per source so historical baselines and incumbent-tenure analysis can be scoped honestly.

brief: Public procurement in North Macedonia is unusually well centralised for intelligence purposes: the ЕСЈН portal (e-nabavki.gov.mk) is the legally mandated single publication point for notices, awards and executed contracts across every contracting authority, backed by the Biro za javni nabavki as regulator, the Државна комисија за жалби as a dispute-disclosure layer, and the Државен завод за ревизија as a post-hoc audit layer that names banking and payment arrangements in text. The practical obstacle is retrieval, not availability — the portal is an ASP.NET application that general web search barely indexes, so collection should run through CPV-coded portal queries or the derived OCDS/Opentender datasets rather than keyword search. A second, entirely English-language stratum sits above the national portal: World Bank procurement plans (notably PFM project P176366 under the Ministry of Finance), EBRD/ECEPP, EIB, WBIF and TED carry donor-funded financial-infrastructure work with forward-looking package lists that appear months before any national advertisement. Highest-value unexplored ground is the roster of state-owned buyers (ФЗОМ, UJP, ЕСМ, Македонска пошта, municipalities) and Albanian-language notices, neither of which this pass covered.
